verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Requesty serves an llms.txt at docs.requesty.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200), and markdown mirrors of docs pages (e.g. quickstart.md) point agents back to that index. The llms.txt also advertises an OpenAPI spec and markdown mirrors of every docs page, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an expanded llms-full.txt or first-party guidance on using the docs with agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.requesty.ai/llms.txt # Requesty
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.requesty.ai/llms.txt
advertised verbatim in the docs llms.txt ("OpenAPI Spec: https://docs.requesty.ai/api-reference/openapi.json") with markdown mirrors of every docs page
